title: Geometry Matters in Packed 3D Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.38694v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Packing a 3D volume into a token sequence is not merely long-sequence modeling. Once the volume is packed, sequence order no longer encodes the geometry of the sample---so a positional mechanism indexed by sequence position can learn the memory layout rather than the object. This is a general failure mode for attention over packed geometric data. We introduce PACK3D, a local-global attention operator that separates memory layout from attention geometry. PACK3D keeps local neighborhood attention exact, compresses only distant context into contiguous 3D block summaries, and indexes every query-key interaction with axial RoPE on true token-grid coordinates rather than packed positions. Because the rotation is applied before a block is summarized, the query-to-summary logit remains a weighted sum of query-relative 3D displacements; compressed global context therefore stays spatially interpretable after packing, instead of collapsing to ano

translated_title: 几何结构在打包3D注意力中的重要性
translated_abstract: 将3D体积打包成token序列并不仅仅是长序列建模问题。一旦体积被打包，序列顺序就不再编码样本的几何结构——因此，以序列位置为索引的位置机制可能学到的是内存布局而非物体本身。这是对打包几何数据进行注意力操作时的一种普遍失败模式。我们提出PACK3D，一种将内存布局与注意力几何分离的局部-全局注意力算子。PACK3D保持局部邻域注意力的精确性，仅将远距离上下文压缩为连续的3D块摘要，并基于真实的token网格坐标（而非打包位置）使用轴向RoPE来索引每一次query-key交互。由于旋转操作在块被摘要之前施加，query到摘要的logit仍然是query相对3D位移的加权和；因此压缩后的全局上下文在打包后依然保持空间可解释性，而不是坍缩为另一种……
tldr: 提出PACK3D局部-全局注意力算子，通过将内存布局与注意力几何分离，并基于真实3D token网格坐标使用轴向RoPE，使打包后压缩的全局上下文保持空间可解释性。
en_tdlr: PACK3D is a local-global attention operator that decouples memory layout from attention geometry, applying axial RoPE on true 3D token-grid coordinates so that compressed global context remains spatially interpretable after packing.
